refuted_claims: RC1 (2.7): the sampler 'returns exactly the SDK's rules 3/4 when the flag is OFF'. FALSE whenever traces_sample_rate != 0.1: sentry-sdk 2.68.1 tracing.py:1215-1232 uses the sampler's return and never consults client.options['traces_sample_rate'] when a sampler is callable; the spec hardcodes 0.1. tests/test_sentry_channels_u8d.py:263-265 and tests/test_retro_w1_1.py:376-378 force traces_sample_rate=1.0 in a child process and assert transactions (u8d :951-956 'every request yielded a transaction'); both go red under the spec's sampler and both are listed in 4.2 as must-stay-green.

RC2 (2.2 real_spec_rows + R6/R8): 'neither value a str whose norm() is in NA_VALUES'. norm('N/A') = 'n a' (the slash becomes a space), not in NA_VALUES; a literal implementation counted 6 Manama 'N/A' rows as REAL (probe w412_row_12_rebuilt.specs_real_rows = 6). R6 ('7/7 N/A vs N/A -> 0') and R8 (partial_no_winner) are unsatisfiable by the spec's own definitions; response_builder uses value.strip().lower() against _SPEC_NA_TOKENS (:590, :677-678).

RC3 (R15/R17): FY25 rest_q_full / rest_pair_full data_coverage == 4. Measured 3: the FY25 fakes return identical specs (test_s75_fanout_identity.py:129-130), prices (:132-135) and ratings (:140-142) for both products, so every scoring_v2 dimension ties (price 85/85, reviews 88/88, value 88/88, feature 90/90, futureproof 90/90) and the dims fact is False under both readings.

RC4 (R16, L2): 'Casio G-Shock watch' vs 'Dior Sauvage eau de parfum' -> product_categories ['electronics','fragrances'] -> unsupported_category. classify_category_from_text('Casio G-Shock watch') returns 'other' (no watch/casio token in _CATEGORY_SYNONYMS, extraction_service.py:1164-1215); the pair is ['other','fragrances'], coherent, supported_result. Measured: 'Samsung Galaxy S24 phone' -> electronics, 'Apple MacBook laptop' -> electronics, 'Dior Sauvage eau de parfum' -> fragrances.

RC5 (R13): w412 rows 15-19 rebuilt through the builder -> data_coverage >= 3. The rebuilt row 15 has both prices PENDED by the chokepoint (amount None, unavailable True; is_price_showable(enforce_correctness=True) at response_builder.py:1700-1712 on the minimised fixture's local_bhd price with no identity stamp) and every rebuilt dimension ties -> coverage <= 2 (ratings only, plus at most one real spec row). The tally's 'full coverage' was on STORED rows, not a rebuild.
RC6 (R8): metadata.product_categories == ['grocery','grocery'] with product_categories=[c, c], c = the row category; rows 12-14 carry category_used == 'other', so the recipe yields ['other','other'].

RC7 (1.2 / 2.5): 'A success:False body never reaches these points (camera :532-534 / :575-578)'. FALSE with ENABLE_PAID_ROUTE_METERING OFF: unsuccessful_not_billed = comparison_unsuccessful and paid_route_metering_enabled() (image_routes.py:465-467), so an unsuccessful result skips :503-534, is logged, saved (:555), lifetime-bumped, and with the envelope flag also OFF reaches return result at :580 with success False (the test-env default; production has both ON). R18 covers metering ON only.

RC8 (2.2 same_identity / evidence_facts product source): overview.products[i].variant is _compose_variant_string (response_builder.py:1915), a display string composed from specs (probe: rebuilt row 12 shows ['red','blue'] after a colour field was set, while the raw products[i].variant is [None,'250g']); the overview mirror also carries no rating_derived key (it nulls rating at :1920). Reading the mirror first compares colour captions, not sizes.

RC9 (1.1 anchors): metadata.update at :2125-2126 (spec :2109-2112), verdict_scrubbed :2129-2130 (spec :2115-2116), margin :2134-2135 (spec :2119-2120), result['winner_index'] :2243 (spec :2231); tier_context :2249, _strip_inference_markers :2260, return :2262 hold. Symbol-resolvable.

RC10 (3 step 3): 'the two _partial_build_ctx.update({...}) dicts (:4284-4288, :4923-4927)'. The REST site is an .update at :4284-4288 BEFORE the write-back (:4296); the stream site is a dict-literal assignment self._partial_build_ctx = {...} at :4921-4931 AFTER the write-back (:4912). The capture must precede :4284 on REST (or a second update) and :4912 on the stream.
